mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_group ( sys_id, cancel_yn, cancel_reason, insert_user_id, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd, link_sys_id, order_num, order_status ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, 'N', '', 'CONSUMER', #{orderedAt}, #{sysPlantCd}, #{consumerSessionId}, #{orderNumber}, '01' )

INSERT INTO order_detail ( sys_id, link_sys_id, option_yn, insert_user_id, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd, link_sys_id2, link_sys_id3, qty, payment_yn ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{consumerSessionId},
'Y' 'N' , 'CONSUMER', #{orderedAt}, #{sysPlantCd}, #{menuSysId}, #{orderId}, #{quantity}, 'N' )

INSERT INTO order_detail_option ( sys_id, link_sys_id, insert_user_id, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd, link_sys_id2, qty ) VALUES ( #{orderOptionId}, #{orderItemId}, 'CONSUMER', #{orderedAt}, #{sysPlantCd}, #{optionSysId}, #{quantity} )
mapper.sql: INNER JOIN order_master om ON om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND om.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd AND om.insert_user_id = 'CONSUMER'
mapper.select:
SELECT og.sys_id AS order_id, og.order_num AS order_number, og.order_status, COALESCE(SUM( smd.menu_price::bigint * od.qty + COALESCE(option_total.amount, 0) ), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(od.qty), 0) AS item_count, og.insert_datetime AS ordered_at, COALESCE(og.modify_datetime, og.insert_datetime) AS updated_at FROM order_group og
INNER JOIN order_detail od ON od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id AND od.link_sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND od.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd INNER JOIN store_menu_detail smd ON smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 AND smd.sys_plant_cd = od.sys_plant_cd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT odo.link_sys_id AS order_item_id, SUM(smod.menu_option_price::bigint * odo.qty) AS amount FROM order_detail_option odo INNER JOIN store_menu_option_detail smod ON smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 AND smod.sys_plant_cd = odo.sys_plant_cd GROUP BY odo.link_sys_id ) option_total ON option_total.order_item_id = od.sys_id WHERE GROUP BY og.sys_id, og.order_num, og.order_status, og.insert_datetime, og.modify_datetime ORDER BY og.insert_datetime DESC, og.sys_id DESC

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_group og
INNER JOIN order_detail od ON od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id AND od.link_sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND od.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd WHERE AND od.payment_yn = 'Y' )

SELECT og.sys_id AS order_id, og.order_num AS order_number, og.order_status, og.insert_datetime AS ordered_at, COALESCE(og.modify_datetime, og.insert_datetime) AS updated_at FROM order_group og
WHERE AND og.sys_id = #{orderId}

SELECT od.sys_id AS order_item_id, smd.sys_id AS menu_sys_id, smd.menu_name, od.qty AS quantity, smd.menu_price AS menu_unit_amount FROM order_group og
INNER JOIN order_detail od ON od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id AND od.link_sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND od.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd INNER JOIN store_menu_detail smd ON smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 AND smd.sys_plant_cd = od.sys_plant_cd WHERE AND og.sys_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY od.insert_datetime ASC, od.sys_id ASC

SELECT od.sys_id AS order_item_id, smod.sys_id AS option_sys_id, smod.menu_option_name AS option_name, odo.qty AS stored_quantity, smod.menu_option_price AS unit_amount FROM order_group og
INNER JOIN order_detail od ON od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id AND od.link_sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND od.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd INNER JOIN order_detail_option odo ON odo.link_sys_id = od.sys_id AND odo.sys_plant_cd = od.sys_plant_cd INNER JOIN store_menu_option_detail smod ON smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 AND smod.sys_plant_cd = odo.sys_plant_cd WHERE AND og.sys_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY odo.insert_datetime ASC, odo.sys_id ASC
